name: Government of Ireland Postdoctoral Fellowship (GOIPD)
amount: Salary EUR 47,273 (year 1), EUR 47,880 (year 2) + EUR 5,000/year research expenses + employer PRSI
other_rules: PhD held or close to conferral within the call's eligibility window
host must be an eligible Irish research body
mentor at the host submits a separate statement
check the annual call document for citizenship or visa conditions
notes: 2026 call ran 11 Sep to 23 Oct 2025 (mentor statements 6 Nov), outcomes end of April, start 1 Sep. The 2027 call (autumn 2026) was not found on the site; check researchireland.ie. Choose 1 or 2 years at application.
